name: Stripe

tiers.how: Sage connects to Stripe via its official REST API using a secret key stored in the OS credential store. The owner must create a Stripe account, generate an API key in the Stripe dashboard, and store it via setup_creds. Reads are unrestricted; any write (invoice, payment link, refund) requires an approval card before execution.
always_tap: any invoice send to a client

gotchas: Use a restricted key with read-only scopes for Sage's reads and a separate key for executor sends to limit blast radius.
Test mode and live mode use completely different keys; confirm which is configured before any write.
Webhooks can push real-time payment events to Sage; verify the webhook signing secret to prevent spoofed events.
Finalizing and sending an invoice is irreversible without a credit note; always tap before sending.
notes: Stripe is a payments-first tool; Sage reads financial state and drafts invoices but never initiates a charge without owner approval.
